font-family.$description:
Type: body-default font-family (body text, labels, nav, buttons). BELLA DM Sans; Chip Lexend (decided 18 Nov).

How Chip uses its two fonts: Lexend reads: every sentence and label (body, helper, buttons, nav, tabs, fields, tags, pills, table cells, captions, card and section titles); 400 text, 500 labels/nav/tabs, 600 card titles, selected and emphasis; 16px+, line height 1.5. Geist Mono is the brand and the figures: page titles with the red dot, lane names, numbered pins, standalone figures (stat values, 42/44, count pills), code, keys, the Brief label; 600; tighter tracking only at 32px+.
